day1_finds: Glass 30.1 and steady. Fog, then. Climbed the tower. Lens turns smooth on its weights. East stack: old trawler wreck. Canister stamped PROJECT PELAGIC 1974 wedged in the hull. West echo cave: red acoustic buoy in the arch. Battery pack still warm. Shouldn't be. Told Clara about the canister. Kept the buoy to myself.
day3_mixed: Glass 30.0. The glass is calm; the fog is thick as wool. North cove: an armored cable runs from a stone hut out under the sea. Brass tag: PELAGIC ARRAY 2. Under the bed, a loose floorboard and a cassette in Walt's handwriting. Told Clara about the cable and its tag. Played Walt's 1977 tape: the Navy's settlement offer, and June's sister, Ruth.
day6_all: Glass 30.4. Frost on the inside of the window. North cove hut: a biscuit tin with a Coast Guard boat log on cassette. West buoy: fresh service marks, a Coast Guard-issue battery, and a cassette taped under the hatch. Played Tom Dunmore's boat log: he said one hour; they said two. Played Clara's own tape from the buoy. Clara told me everything.
flag_other_day: Glass 28.7 and falling. The needle's nearly off the dial. Quiet day. Nothing new to record.
quiet_day: Glass 29.9, easing down. Grey all day. Quiet day. Nothing new to record.
